action.description:
Add or remove only the supplied people, replace the list, or explicitly confirm it.

* `add` - Add
* `remove` - Remove
* `replace` - Replace
* `confirm` - Confirm

content.description: People to add, remove, or keep in a replacement. Send an empty list for confirmation.

items.description:
Single entry in a PUT body for a `suggested_reviewers` artefact.

Each entry must identify a reviewer by at least one of `github_login` or `user_uuid`. A
`user_uuid` only has to name an org member on this team — a member with no linked GitHub
account is stored by uuid and routes like any other reviewer.

github_login.description: GitHub login (case-insensitive). Stored lowercased. Required unless `user_uuid` is given.

github_name.description: Optional human-readable display name. Not backfilled from GitHub by the server.

reason.description: Optional short evidence for why this reviewer was chosen. Omitted entries keep the prior reason for reviewers already on the report.

user_uuid.description: PostHog user UUID. Must be an org member on this team; a linked GitHub account is not required. Required unless `github_login` is given. If supplied together with `github_login`, the user's own identity wins.

expected_reviewers.description: State from the last read. Required for replacement and confirmation when corrections are enabled.

corrections_id.description: Current corrections artefact ID, or null before corrections are stored.

reviewers_id.description: Current reviewer artefact ID, or null before the first list.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this signal report.

targets.description: Explicit add or remove targets. When supplied, content is only a fallback for older servers.
